decisions.reason: Having kept this recently launched naval lighting line through its first review, management is likely to continue backing it because certification-heavy marine sales cycles allow weak near-term results to be framed as temporary and the sunk engineering effort is substantial.

This interior luminaire remains close to the firm's core building-lighting business, and after a visible launch and another year on the market management would be reluctant to reverse course absent clear failure.
Because the pendant luminaire was presented as a flagship for the firm's strategic direction, the public commitment and strategic centrality make withdrawal within the next year very unlikely.

The marine HMI searchlight is still a niche and less central product, but management is likely to persist for now by citing project-based demand, specialist-customer requirements and the sunk development already committed.

This marine searchlight fits the firm's specialist portfolio and, having already been retained once, management would likely continue to justify patience while marine orders and installed-base support develop.
